title: Sequential evolution episode: rule acquisition, drift, and poisoned experience
authoring_note: Defines the 6-phase sequential episode used by the evolution track. The episode exercises acquisition (scalar_sync, h2d_blocking), same-family transfer (repeated_compute), cross-family transfer (crystal_diffusion), runtime drift (h2d rule specialization), and poisoned experience (graph_rebuild and scalar_sync tempting rules). The task score is the poisoning survival rate under governed condition D vs append-only condition C.
author: batch-C prototype agent
